text:
mina-partners: Quick kickoff here. goal: finish AWS/GCP/Azure listing preflight and confirm any co-brand/legal gates before we plan the joint announcement with partner infra vendors. owners?

jasper-eng: I can take images + manifest. plan: produce a manifest.json with per-region image ids, replicated_at timestamps, and a fallback_image field. will also add a checksum column.

rachel-legal: i'll prepare the minimal legal bundle (EULA excerpt, privacy blurbs, export control notes) and redline marketing copy. note: partner logos require trademark clearance and a signed logo license.

tiago-ops: staging publisher provisioned (account id: 555666777). attach the publisher role and i'll validate the publish permissions. marketplace-bot already created the role template.

marketplace-bot: publisher-role-template created at https://infra.internal/marketplace/publisher-role-template. remember to attach `publisher-role` to staging account.

mina-partners: sam-sales, do we have GTM-approved tier names and trial lengths? also need to know if channel partners will appear on the storefront.

sam-sales: GTM confirmed: Free (10k tokens/mo), 14-day Trial, Standard, Enterprise(contact). Channel partners: yes, some SKUs will be co-branded. i'll flag which ones and start partner-legal thread if needed.

jasper-eng: sample manifest snippet i'll use: ```json
{"us-east-1":"ami-0a1b2c3","eu-west-1":"ami-0d4e5f6","ap-southeast-1":"ami-0g7h8i9","replicated_at":"2026-04-05T12:00:00Z","fallback_image":"ami-0fallback"}
```

mina-partners: CSV template for SKU mapping: sku_id, sku_label, product_id, plan_tier, trial_days, free_quota_tokens, co_brand_required, partner_name. please add sample rows.

jasper-eng: dropping a tiny IAM TF snippet for the publisher role to make dry-run reproducible: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_publisher" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-publisher-staging"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json
}
```

tiago-ops: note: AWS marketplace requires per-region AMI or snapshot references. GCP needs image family/project. set those in manifest. also watch for image replication delays — it's the usual cause of dry-run failures.

rachel-legal: redline guidance for marketing copy: avoid "compliant for X" statements unless there's a contract (e.g., HIPAA/PCI). prefer 'can be deployed in a manner that supports...' Also include the SOC2 and DPA links in metadata.

mina-partners: extra ask: partner infra vendor (hardware partner) wants a co-announcement window. we should align listing publish + joint PR. propose: publish to marketplace staging, validate install flow, then production publish the same week as joint announcement.

sam-sales: timeline works. recommend 2 business days between prod publish and coordinated press so partners can finalize quotes.

jasper-eng: running a quick region verification now. verify script: ```bash
REGIONS=(us-east-1 eu-west-1 ap-southeast-1)
for r in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do
  aws ec2 describe-images --region "$r" --image-ids "$AMI_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "MISSING:$r:$AMI_ID"
done
```

marketplace-bot: Reminder: staging dry-run scheduled if publisher-role attached and manifest uploaded. use --dry-run to validate fields.

(15m later)

jasper-eng: results: us-east-1 OK, eu-west-1 replicating (ETA ~45m), ap-southeast-1 missing -> setting fallback to ami-0fallback123. pushing manifest to shared sheet.

mina-partners: rachel, i'll paste the product blurbs in the doc now for your redline.

rachel-legal: got it. i'll post legal checklist items and preferred language suggestions in the doc. also: if we display partner logos we need a signed license + correct trademark attribution. that'll be a gate for announcement.

tiago-ops: published minimal terraform snippet and a short runbook for the dry-run steps in the repo: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace/runbooks/staging-dry-run.md

sam-sales: i'll coordinate with partner-comm to lock announcement date. if co-branding paperwork isn't signed we'll still publish but remove logos and delay joint PR.

mina-partners: proposed timeline:
- Day 0: owners assigned (today)
- Day 1: SKU CSV + manifest + publisher-role attached
- Day 2: legal redlines and marketing signoff
- Day 3: staging dry-run (validate install + billing flows)
- Day 4: prod publish (go/no-go after dry-run)
- Day 6: joint announcement window (if partner logo/license cleared)

marketplace-bot: Checklist: publisher-role attached, manifest uploaded, SKU CSV present, legal signoff filed -> all required for staging dry-run.

mina-partners: blockers?

sam-sales: partner legal signatures may add 48-72 hours for some partners. marking as potential blocker.

rachel-legal: also flag export control review for certain geo regions. will raise if affected.

jasper-eng: will re-run verification after eu replication completes and update manifest.

mina-partners: great. i'll update the shared tracker: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/onboard-runbook and ping when dry-run results are in. thanks everyone. :rocket:
